responsibility: This file implements compile-time simplification of intrinsic functions and related conversions. Its routines fold constant intrinsic calls, perform kind/default-kind validation, enforce range checks, manipulate mpz/mpfr representations for signedness and bit-level semantics, convert constant arrays and character values across kinds, and provide compile-time answers for inquiry intrinsics such as compiler_options/version and selected IEEE intrinsics used during semantic simplification.
